basics.name: Karine Duarte Justino
basics.label: Data Scientist & AI Alignment Specialist
basics.summary: Data Scientist and AI Alignment Specialist leveraging a clinical neuropsychology foundation to evaluate, fine-tune, and align Large Language Models. Proven track record of architecting scalable PySpark ETL pipelines for 15TB+ multimodal datasets, deploying PyTorch models with 99.2% accuracy, and implementing rigorous RLHF rubrics that reduced dataset bias by 40%. Passionate about ensuring generative AI safety, fairness, and compliance across complex clinical and financial domains.

work.name: RWS Group
highlights: Architected and managed PySpark ETL pipelines to process and clean 15TB+ of multimodal datasets for model training.
Fine-tuned Hugging Face Transformer models, maintaining a strict 99.2% model accuracy across deployment cycles.
Deployed PyTorch fairness algorithms and evaluation rubrics, successfully reducing dataset bias by 40%.
Collaborated with cross-functional AI teams to ensure data integrity and model compliance at scale.

work.name: Stealth AI Lab & Alignerr
highlights: Evaluated Large Language Model (LLM) outputs against strict Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) safety rubrics.
Designed complex prompt architectures and adversarial red-teaming strategies to stress-test generative models.
Curated and annotated high-quality gold training datasets for LLM fine-tuning and behavioral alignment.
